Definition: Mattenai, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Mattenai is the name of three men after the exile: two who had taken foreign wives and put them away. A third Mattenai served as a priest of the course of Joiarib in Nehemiah's day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name shows both sides of the return: men who repented of mixed marriages, and a priest who served in the restored temple, and the same name covers the sorrow and the rebuilding.
